ITEM 1 | Large folded pale-green leaf with darker green edges and a lighter midrib, glossy and slightly wilted, sitting at top of the pile, about 6 cm long and 4 cm wide, slightly curled and moist-looking | 15
ITEM 2 | Cluster of dark green crinkled leafy greens with lighter pale-green inner leaves, matte and fibrous with visible veins, covering the center of the pile, about 9 cm by 6 cm, piled loosely with some folds and moisture on surfaces | 40
ITEM 3 | Small halved red cherry tomato-like pieces, glossy bright red skin with pale interior, about 2 cm across, one piece resting near the top of the greens | 8
ITEM 4 | Dark reddish-brown shredded pieces with a slightly wrinkled, chewy texture, clustered at left and right edges of the greens, each piece about 2 to 3 cm long, dry-looking with slight sheen | 6
ITEM 5 | Small orange-red fragments scattered at the base of the greens, irregular and moist-looking, each under 1 cm, possibly sauce residue sitting on the white plate | 2
